app.name: Rare Disease Planet
app.tagline: Every pin is a person. Every person is not alone.
app.footer: Country, rare disease, and variant are always on the globe. Email is never public.

home.emptyTitle: The globe is quiet — for now.
home.emptyBody: Be the first to place a light. Your country, rare disease, and variant (if you add one) will appear as a pin.
home.hintRotate: Drag to turn the planet · tap a pin to read it

survey.title: Join Rare Disease Planet
survey.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
survey.privacyLead: Before you start: on the globe we always show country, rare disease, and variant (if you add one). Everything else stays private unless you turn it on.
survey.privacyVariant: Variant — visible when you add one
survey.privacyPrivate: Name, role, town/city, feature picks, and free-text stay private by default.
survey.consentLabel: I understand what will appear on the globe and I consent to Rare Disease Planet storing my answers in order to place a pin and (if I choose) join a group.
survey.updatesLabel: Send me occasional updates about Rare Disease Planet (optional).
survey.globeIntro: These three fields are the public story of your pin. Review them carefully.
survey.variantHint: For example an exon, CAG repeat, or gene variant. Shown on the globe if you add it.
survey.townToggle: Show town / city on the globe
survey.townToggleHelp: Off by default. We still never store or show a street address — only a coarse country pin.
survey.pinPreviewEmpty: Choose a country and rare disease to preview your pin.
survey.privateIntro: These answers are private. Email is never shown on the globe.
survey.displayNameHint: Not shown on the globe in this version.
survey.emailNever: Never public. Used only to update your pin and reach you if you asked for updates.
survey.features: What would help most? Pick up to 3
survey.featuresHint: Private wishlist — not shown on the globe.
survey.groupIntro: Create a public group others can find, a private family (invite only), or join with a code.
survey.invalidInvite: We could not find that invite. You can still place a pin.
survey.publicNote: Public groups always show their name and how many members have joined.
survey.privateNote: Private families are invite-link only. They are not listed in the open directory.
survey.reviewTitle: This is what the planet will show
survey.reviewLead: On the globe we always show country, rare disease, and variant (if you added one). Everything else stays private unless you turned it on.
survey.reviewTownPublic: Town / city — you chose to show this
survey.reviewName: Display name — not on the globe

features.same_condition: Find others with the same condition

groups.title: Open groups
groups.lead: Joinable groups always show a name and how many members have joined so far.
groups.empty: No public groups yet. Start the survey to create one.

thanks.title: You are on the planet.
thanks.body: Your pin is live. Country, rare disease, and variant (if you added one) are what others can see.
thanks.back: See my pin on the globe
thanks.inviteHelp: Share this link or QR. Private families join only this way. Public groups also appear in the open directory.
thanks.addFamilyLead: A child, sibling, or anyone in your family — each person gets their own pin. Email is optional here and still never public.
thanks.added: Their pin is on the planet.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach Rare Disease Planet. Check your connection.
errors.email_taken: That email is already on the planet. Use a different email, or skip email for a family member.
errors.invite_invalid: That invite code was not found.
errors.no_group: Create or join a group before adding family.
errors.unauthorized: This invite session has expired. Submit the survey again.
